page_title: PAL 0-1 RAY | Las Palmas v Rayo Vallecano 09/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Francisco Maeso has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
90+4' Jose Campana (Las Palmas) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
90+1' A cross into the box from Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) is cleared.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
89' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
84' Jose Campana (Las Palmas) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
83' Pelayo Fernandez (Rayo Vallecano) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Alvaro Garcia.
82' Juanma Herzog (Las Palmas) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
82' Jose Campana (Las Palmas) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
81' Jose Campana (Las Palmas) takes the corner which is cleared.
81' The game has come to an end for Stefan Bajcetic. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas).
78' A yellow card is awarded to Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano).
78' Inigo Perez has decided to make a change. Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Andrei Ratiu.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Oscar Valentin.
77' Jose Campana (Las Palmas) takes the corner kick, but Augusto Batalla reads it well and stops the effort.
76' That was close! Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) makes a good run into the centre of the box and gets his head onto a lofted pass, but sends the ball a fraction over the bar.
76' Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
76' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
76' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
74' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Dinko Horkas has no trouble gathering it.
70' The manager makes a subsitution with Sandro Ramirez coming on for Javier Munoz (Las Palmas).
70' Diego Martinez prepares a substitution. Adnan Januzaj is replaced by Jaime Mata (Las Palmas).
70' It will be a substitution. Jose Campana is ready to enter the pitch as Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) walks off.
69' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but it's just a bit too high and misses the bar by a whisker.

66' 0 - 1 Goal! Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) latches on to a superb pass inside the box, finds himself in a promising position and fires a shot in off the crossbar. The goalkeeper was helpless to keep out his effort.
64' Marvin (Las Palmas) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
63' The resulting corner, taken by Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano), comes to nothing.

62' CHANCE! Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) goes very close! He gathers a cross inside the box and fires a sublime shot towards the right side of the goal, but Dinko Horkas produces an excellent save. Rayo Vallecano will take a corner kick.
61' Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes high over the bar.
59' Substitution. Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Unai Lopez walks off.
59' It's time for a substitution. Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) comes on in place of Adrian Embarba.
57' Here is a change. Dario Essugo is going off and Diego Martinez gives the last tactical orders to Marvin (Las Palmas).
55' Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
54' Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) is awarded a yellow card.
53' Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
53' The attendance is 20577.
52' Viti (Las Palmas) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
51' Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
50' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul.
48' Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes narrowly wide of the right post.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
44' Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) gets a yellow card.

42' Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) latches on to a lofted pass from the resulting set piece and pulls the trigger from around the penalty spot. His effort low towards the middle of the goal is saved by the excellent Augusto Batalla.
41' Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
41' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul.
40' Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
36' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) sends it out of play. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
35' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the right post.
33' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) sends the corner into the box, but Dinko Horkas intercepts it and averts the threat.

32' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear. Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
30' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
30' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
26' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
24' Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post.
22' The resulting corner from Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

22' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Rayo Vallecano.
21' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
18' Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
16' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
16' Referee Francisco Maeso sees the trip by Stefan Bajcetic (Las Palmas) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
14' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
9' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
6' The whipped in corner perfectly picks out Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) near the penalty spot, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes a mile over the bar.
5' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
4' Wow, what an escape. Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Las Palmas will take the kick-off.
Francisco Maeso will officiate today.
